title: nf-core/abotyper pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and may contain only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq', '.fastq', '.fq.gz', or '.fastq.gz'

control.errorMessage: control must be empty, 'negative' (no-template control) or 'positive' (positive control)

barcode.errorMessage: barcode must be empty, a number (07) or barcode<number> (barcode07)
